regions.today: Remaining cloudy this evening with patchy rain and drizzle clearing eastwards before further outbreaks of rain arrive later, with mostly light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy at first with outbreaks of rain and drizzle arriving from the west, becoming more showery later, with clear spells developing before dawn. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees, with moderate southwesterly winds, fresher along the coast.
regions.tomorrow: Rather cloudy with scattered showers at first. Showers will become more isolated, with sunny spells developing at times through the day. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees, with moderate to fresh westerly winds, stronger along the coast.
